title: Flamehaven MICA Universal v0.1.8.1
description: Memory Invocation & Context Archive for AI -- universal schema v0.1.8.1. Patch over v0.1.8 adding three changes: (1) selfTestCheck.expression field for machine-evaluable predicates using the MICA expression micro-language, (2) invocationProtocol.self_test_runtime field identifying which runtime executes self_test_policy checks, (3) trackEntry.invariants description clarified to make designInvariantEntry.track the authoritative source and trackEntry.invariants a derived field whose divergence is a detectable drift condition.

mica_schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Allows validators to identify the schema version without parsing $id.

design_invariants.description: Structured design invariants. Breaking change from v0.1.7 (was array of strings). Each entry is a designInvariantEntry object.

examples.description: Optional illustrative examples. Examples are non-normative and must not substitute for scope, scoring weights, or gate semantics.

track_map.description: Optional. Universal equivalent of MICA-LAB track_decomposition. Maps logical track IDs to file groups and applicable invariants.

designInvariantEntry.description: A structured design invariant. v0.1.8 replaces plain string entries with typed objects for richer tracking and validation.

label.description: Short human-readable name for the invariant.

track.description: Track ID this DI applies to. Absent means the invariant applies to all tracks.

modelShapeDescriptor.description: Spec-level shape descriptor only. This defines the expected field names and their roles for documentation and spec validation. It is NOT a runtime instance validator. Runtime validation must use dedicated Pydantic/TypeScript models.

steps.description: Legacy string-list steps. Retained for backward compatibility.

pipeline_steps.description: Optional structured step definitions for richer implementation metadata. Added in v0.1.8.

collectorPipelineStep.description: Structured collector pipeline step. Added in v0.1.8 alongside legacy string steps.

produces.description: Field names or artifact names this step produces.

equation.const: score = sum_i(w_i * x_i), x_i in [0,1], weights normalized by sum, score clamped to [0,1]

v0_1_7_to_v0_1_8.description: Migration note: v0.1.8 breaks v0.1.7 on design_invariants. The field changes from array of strings to array of designInvariantEntry objects. All string entries must be converted to structured objects with id, label, statement, severity.

slo_hints.description: Recommended SLO guardrails. Cross-field ordering constraints (p95 <= p99, degraded_rate_warn < degraded_rate_critical) cannot be enforced by JSON Schema alone. These MUST be validated by application-level validators (e.g. Pydantic model_validator) or CI semantic checks.

p95_context_compile_ms.description: Must be <= p99_context_compile_ms. Enforced by application validator.

p99_context_compile_ms.description: Must be >= p95_context_compile_ms. Enforced by application validator.

degraded_rate_warn.description: Must be < degraded_rate_critical. Enforced by application validator.

degraded_rate_critical.description: Must be > degraded_rate_warn. Enforced by application validator.

labels.description: Optional categorization labels (e.g. ['primary_protocol', 'session_anchor']). Added in v0.1.8.

deviationLogEntry.description: v0.1.8 relaxes required fields. Only change_id, timestamp_utc, reason are required. gate, before_hash, after_hash, approved_by, rollback_ready are now optional. New optional fields: impact, track, date.

track.description: Track ID this deviation applies to.

invocation_notes.description: Optional notes about how this archive is invoked in AI sessions. Added in v0.1.8.

last_self_test_result.description: Result of the most recent self_test_policy execution. Added in v0.1.8.

invocationProtocol.description: Declares how the MICA archive reaches an AI session. Added in v0.1.8.

loading_order.description: Ordered list of file paths to load (e.g. ['memory/project.mica-lab.json', 'memory/project.mica.json']).

skill_name.description: Agent Skills name when primary_pattern is global_skill.

self_test_runtime.description: Identifies the normative runtime that executes self_test_policy checks. 'readme_protocol_ai_session' means the AI session executing [AI Session Protocol] steps is the self-test runner -- file_exists checks are satisfied by read attempts, inline_invariants_match by README scan. 'hybrid' means both AI session and a secondary validator.

sessionReportFormat.description: Defines the normative format for the session opening report that AI must produce after loading MICA. Added in v0.1.8.

required_fields.description: Fields the AI must include in the session opening report (e.g. ['gate', 'test_counts', 'active_invariants', 'track']).

format_template.description: Template text with {placeholder} tokens for required_fields.

gate_block_on.description: Conditions that prevent the AI from proceeding (e.g. ['stage_gate_final==BLOCK']).

driftResponsePolicy.description: Normalizes how AI responds to provenance hash mismatches and file modifications. Added in v0.1.8.

reminder_after_change.description: If true, AI reminds user to update provenance_registry after modifying registered files.

inline_sync_required.description: If true, inline_invariants in README must be verified against design_invariants on each update.

selfTestPolicy.description: Defines runnable self-tests the MICA archive executes to validate itself against real-world project state. Distinct from self_consistency_policy which checks internal document consistency. Added in v0.1.8.

selfTestCheck.description: A single self-test check within selfTestPolicy. Added in v0.1.8. v0.1.8.1 adds optional expression field for machine-evaluable predicates.

on_fail.description: Action description when this check fails.

target.description: Specific field path or file to check.

expression.description: Machine-evaluable predicate using MICA expression micro-language (see MICA_v0.1.8_UNIVERSAL_USAGE.md section 10). Path references use JSONPath subset ($.field[*].subfield). Permitted functions: exists(), all(), any(), match(), len(), contains(), file_exists(). Boolean operators: and, or, not. Comparison: ==, !=, >=, <=. Expression must evaluate to boolean. Absence means check is human-only.

trackMap.description: Optional. Maps logical track IDs to file groups and applicable invariants. Universal equivalent of MICA-LAB track_decomposition. Added in v0.1.8.

trackEntry.description: A single logical track within the track_map. Added in v0.1.8.

files.description: Relative paths of files belonging to this track.

invariants.description: DERIVED field. Authoritative source is designInvariantEntry.track. List the DI IDs whose designInvariantEntry.track matches this track ID. Do NOT edit this field directly -- update designInvariantEntry.track instead. Divergence between this list and DI track assignments is a drift condition detectable by self_test check_type='track_map_files_registered'.
